say:2:1041576101:1.text: Forgive my rudeness, but tell me, do you also harbor an obsession with life and death?
say:2:1041576101:1.source_cn: 恕我失礼，阁下，你的内心中是否也有着关于生死的执念？

say:4:1041576103:1.text: I can see it... There is a resolve in your eyes that mirrors my own. Or rather, it mirrors the man I used to be.
say:4:1041576103:1.source_cn: 我能看出来……你的眼神中有着与我相似的执着。或者说，与...

say:5:1041576104:0.text: I once held my own "life" in contempt, seeing true liberation within the hollow weight of immortality. It was only recently that I found something worth living for.
say:5:1041576104:0.source_cn: 我曾对自己的“生命”不屑一顾，在漫长的永生中寻找着真正...

say:7:1041576106:0.text: But we are not the same.

say:8:1041576107:1.text: You were obsessed with your own death. I, however, am trying to reclaim the only life that could ever bring warmth to these freezing waters.
say:8:1041576107:1.source_cn: 你执着于自己的“死”，而我在试着寻回那冰冷的海水中，唯...

say:9:1041576108:1.text: Then your fixation is tied to another person.
say:9:1041576108:1.source_cn: 如此看来，你的执念是关于他人的。

say:10:1041576109:1.text: My wife. Her absence is temporary. I... I will bring her back.
say:10:1041576109:1.source_cn: 我的妻子。但她的离去是暂时的，而我……一定会将她复活。

say:11:1041576110:1.text: You intend to turn her into a Graveborn as well?

say:12:1041576111:1.text: No. She is far too beautiful to become a mindless husk, rotting away through an endless, agonizing existence. I will have her return to my side exactly as she was: radiant and full of life.
say:12:1041576111:1.source_cn: 亡灵……不，她如此美好，不该在漫长的时间中变得浑浑噩噩...

say:13:1041576112:1.text: I understand your grief, but what you ask cannot be done. To return as a Graveborn is one thing, but for the dead to return to the flesh is a line that cannot be crossed. It is a law written into the very fabric of our world.
say:13:1041576112:1.source_cn: 阁下，让你的妻子复活为亡灵尚有先例，但死者不会再以鲜活...

say:14:1041576113:1.text: I have seen "resurrection" before. It is never the person you remember, only a demonic mockery that leaves nothing but wreckage in its wake. Please, for your own sake... let this go.
say:14:1041576113:1.source_cn: “死者复活为生前的样子”……我曾见过这样一幕，相信我，...

say:15:1041576114:1.text: The sea gave us life. It is something you surface-dwellers will never comprehend.
say:15:1041576114:1.source_cn: 大海给予我们的生命奥秘，你们陆上之人永远不会明白。

say:16:1041576115:1.text: I will find her. I will reach into the depths and pull her back, even if it takes a thousand years... even if I have to outlast time itself.
say:16:1041576115:1.source_cn: 我一定能带回她，哪怕花费一千年、一万年……
